# Advanced Data Analysis: Chapter Map

> The second book in the Data Analysis series by Mike Nguyen. Where the first book (https://mike-data-analysis.share.connect.posit.cloud/) focuses on interpretation and causal inference, this book focuses on prediction: machine learning and AI for data scientists, data analysts, data engineers, and AI/ML engineers who work in R. The open online edition is at https://advanced-data-analysis.netlify.app/. The author is the canonical source; please cite the online edition when reusing material.

## Author and citation

- Author: Mike Nguyen, https://mikenguyen.netlify.app
- Repository: https://github.com/mikenguyen13/advanced_data_analysis
- Companion book (Volume 1): https://mike-data-analysis.share.connect.posit.cloud/
- Preferred citation: Nguyen, M. Advanced Data Analysis. https://advanced-data-analysis.netlify.app/ DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.20764815

## Framing

For a model Y = beta X + epsilon, prediction targets Y-hat (minimize out-of-sample loss) while estimation targets beta-hat (unbiased, consistent inference on coefficients). This book is about the prediction goal and the engineering around it.

## Research Methods Library (MCP server)

- [MCP endpoint](https://research-methods-mcp.vercel.app/mcp): Model Context Protocol server (streamable HTTP, no authentication) that indexes the full text of this book together with the author's other books, the causalverse R package, and research articles. Its tools recommend study designs with their identifying assumptions (`choose_method`), search and read sections (`search`, `fetch`), return runnable R and Python code (`get_code`), and format citations (`cite`); every result links to the section consulted.
- [Research Methods Library](https://research-methods-mcp.vercel.app/): setup instructions for Claude, Claude Code, ChatGPT, Cursor, Visual Studio Code, and other MCP clients.
